title: PT and PVEM Balk at Morena's Unilateral Governorship Coordinator Picks
detail: Morena's governing allies PT and PVEM publicly questioned the ruling party's rollout of state coordinators for the 2027 gubernatorial races on August 28, saying only two of the five announced picks — Nora Ruvalcaba in Aguascalientes and Imelda Castro in Sinaloa — had their backing. PT leader Benjamín Robles said his party wanted joint 'Juntos Hacemos Historia' coalition polling conducted in Campeche, Colima, and Querétaro before any coordinator was recognized there, arguing Morena had short-circuited the agreed survey method by naming picks unilaterally. Neither PT nor PVEM representatives joined the public presentation events for the contested states, exposing strain inside the coalition roughly a year before the midterm elections.
